title: MedlinePlus · Medicines after bypass surgery
text: Contact your prescribing team before stopping a heart medicine. Your discharge instructions contain the schedule specific to you.
tags: meds pills prescription dose skip missed medicines medication stop

title: MedlinePlus · Activity after bypass surgery
text: MedlinePlus describes gradually increasing activity after bypass surgery. Ask your surgeon about your own restrictions and when you can drive.
tags: exercise walk walking drive driving activity lifting

title: MedlinePlus · Wound care after bypass surgery
text: Follow your surgeon’s directions for cleaning the incision. Ask the surgical team before applying creams or powders.
